model_annotation:
This plot illustrates the coverage metric as a function of the number of completions for four model variants on a distillation dataset. The x-axis is labeled "Number of completions (k)" and uses a linear scale with tick marks at values 2⁰, 2¹, 2², 2³, 2⁴, 2⁵, 2⁶, 2⁷, and 2⁸ (i.e., 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32, 64, 128, 256). The y-axis is labeled "Coverage" and spans approximately from 0.4 to 0.9 on a linear scale, with tick marks at 0.4, 0.5, 0.6, 0.7, 0.8, and 0.9.

Four lines are shown in the plot, each distinguished by color and marker. The line for "Llamba-3B" (shown in blue with circle markers, solid line) starts at approximately 0.55 at k=1 and rises to roughly 0.88 at k=256, following a monotonically increasing, concave trajectory. The line for "Llamba-3B + FT" (shown in orange with square markers, solid line) follows a very similar path, starting near 0.55 and reaching approximately 0.88, largely overlapping with the Llamba-3B line. The line for "Llama-1B" (shown in green with triangle markers, solid line) starts at approximately 0.45 at k=1 and increases to roughly 0.82 at k=256, also following a concave increasing trend but consistently below the 3B model lines. The line for "Llama-1B + FT" (shown in red with diamond markers, solid line) tracks very closely with the Llama-1B line, starting near 0.45 and reaching approximately 0.82 at k=256. All four lines show a steep initial increase that gradually levels off at higher numbers of completions.
